body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Dell launched 15.4-inch entertainment notebook 'Inspiron 1525' during CES 2008. The Inspiron 1525 features Intel Core 2 Duo T5450(1.66GHz) and 15.4-inch wide LCD(1200x800). It supports up to 250GB HDD and 4GB memory. Suggested price is 499USD.
